subject: Peregrine Health — Action sheet & decision checkpoints
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Asha Rao <asha.rao@peregrinehealth.com>, Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@peregrinehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: action sheet + quick recap from today's call

Hi Asha / Michael — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap below so we have shared clarity and can align stakeholders. I attached a one-page action sheet (Peregrine_Action_Sheet_v1.xlsx) with milestones, owners, and target dates. Please review and tell me if anything below needs to change.

TL;DR (what we heard)
- Pain: Search & triage for patient documents is slow and error-prone; clinicians lose ~5–8 mins per case.
- Goal: Reduce clinician triage time by 40% and improve first-pass relevance for downstream coding.
- Must-have: HIPAA-safe deployment, audit logs, and VPC/private deployment option for PHI.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Pilot scope definition — sample dataset + success criteria (owner: Peregrine clinical lead) — target: 2026-06-30
2) Infra & security review — network diagram + least-privilege access (owner: Redwood infra) — target: 2026-07-07
3) Pilot run (2 weeks) — performance & quality evaluation vs baseline (owner: Peregrine ops + Redwood SRE) — start: 2026-07-12
4) Decision & rollout planning — exec review, procurement, SLA negotiation (owner: Peregrine exec) — target decision: 2026-08-05

Stakeholders (from today's call)
- Peregrine: Dr. Asha Rao (Clinical Sponsor), Michael Thompson (IT Procurement), Sara Lin (Security, not on call today)
- Redwood: Soojin Lee (AE), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Eng), Monica Patel (CS lead)

Open questions / risks
- Data access: can we get a de-identified sample set for the pilot? Michael, can you confirm data delivery format and timeline?
- Security evidence: you requested SOC2 evidence and network requirements — attached is a short tech doc (redwood-network-requirements.pdf); we'll follow with our SOC2 auditor pack if needed.
- Cost model: we discussed a short-term pilot estimate vs committed Dedicated pricing; we'll surface a ballpark in the next email.

Next steps (simple asks)
- Asha: confirm pilot success criteria (sample size, metrics) by 2026-06-22.
- Michael: share data transport method and point of contact for security (Sara or IT) by 2026-06-23.
- Redwood: we will update the attached action sheet with explicit dates and a first-pass pilot estimate by 2026-06-19.

Thanks — I left action items in the attached sheet and added owners. If it helps, Dylan can join a short call with your network/security lead to walk through the diagram.

Best,
SoojIn Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Peregrine_Action_Sheet_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-network-requirements.pdf (pdf)

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: action sheet + quick recap from today's call

Thanks Soojin — helpful summary and appreciate the clear owners. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot success criteria: reduce triage time by 35-40% measured over 2,000 case records; boost first-pass relevance (top-3) for coding by 20% vs current pipeline. I'll share a short doc with metric definitions by Monday.
- Data: we can provide a de-identified slice of 2,500 records in CSV. Michael will confirm the secure transfer method.
- Security: Sara Lin will own the security sign-off. Dylan — if you can do a 30-min walkthrough of the network diagram next week, that would be great.

Also — procurement: we typically need a statement of work + an initial pilot quote to route internally. Michael, can you confirm the procurement timeline?

Thanks,
Asha
Chief Clinical Informatics Officer | Peregrine Health
asha.rao@peregrinehealth.com

Quick notes on items I will cover in the walkthrough:
- VPC architecture and optional on-prem connector patterns
- Data-in-flight & at-rest encryption, KMS options (customer-managed keys supported)
- Audit logs and retention options (we can keep detailed S3 logs + audit export to your SIEM)

If you can confirm which time works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read. Also flagging that if Peregrine wants to run the pilot on Dedicated capacity we can prepare a short pilot quote that includes a 2-week reserved window and test data ingress assistance.
